senses.gloss:
उशत् a.
—1 Beautiful; तेनायं स उशत्तमः Bhāg. 1. 3. 14. जायेव पत्य
 उशती सुवासाः Mbh. 1. 1. 1.
—2 Dear, beloved; बद्धः स्वकर्मभिरुशत्तम तेऽड्घ्रिमूलम् Bhāg. 7. 9. 16.
—3 Pure, sinless; विवेकेनोशतात्मना Bhāg. 7. 7. 24; उशतीं गिरम् 4. 2. 13.
—4 Impure, obscene; वर्जयेदुशतीं वाचम् Mb. 12. 235. 10.

उशनस् m. [वश्-कनसि संप्र˚ Uṇ. 4. 238] (Nom. sing. उशना;
 Voc. sing. उशनन्, उशन, उशनः) N. of Śukra, regent of the planet
 Venus, son of Bhṛgu and preceptor of the Asuras. In the Vedas he has
 the epithet (or patronymic name) Kāvya given to him, probably because
 he was noted for his wisdom; मित्रावरुणावुशनां काव्यम् (अवथः)
 Av. 4. 29. 6. cf. कवीनामुशना कविः Bg. 10. 37; He is also known
 as a writer on civil and religious law (Y. 1. 4). and as an authority on
 civil polity; शास्त्रमुशनसा प्रणीतम् Pt. 5; अध्यापितस्योशनसापि
 नीतिम् Ku. 3. 6.
.━{@Comp.@}: उशनःप्रियम्
उशनस् + -प्रियम् A kind of gem Called गोमेद (वैडूर्य ?)
उशना ind. Ved. Joyfully, willingly.

उशाना Ved.
—1 Wish, desire,
—2 The plant from which Soma juice is produced.
—3 N. of a wife of Rudra.

—1 Injurious talk.
—2 Cutting speech.
उषती = उशती q. v.
उष a. Burning.

उषा [ओषत्यन्धकारम् उष्-क]
—1 Early morning, dawn; उषामुषां श्रेयसीं धेह्यस्मै Av. 12. 2. 45.
—2 Morning light.
—3 Twilight.
—4 Saline earth.
—5 A cow.
—6 Night.
—7 A boiler, cooking vessel (स्थाली); cf. उखा.
—8 N. of a wife of Bhava (who was a manifestation of Rudra). —9 N. of a
 daughter of the demon Bāṇa and wife of Aniruddha. [She beheld Aniruddha
 in a dream and became passionately enamoured of him. She sought the assistance
 of her friend Chitralekhā, who advised her to have with her the portraits
 of all young princes living round about her. When this was done, she recognized
 Aniruddha and had him carried to her city, where she was married to him;
 see अनिरुद्ध also]. ━ind.
—1 Early in the morning.
—2 At night.
.━{@Comp.@}: उषाकलः, उषापतिः, उषारमणः, उषेशः
ऊषा = उषा q. v.

उष + .{@-षः@}
—1 Early morning, dawn, day-break.
—2 A libidinous man,
—3 Saline earth.
—4 Bdellium.

ऊषः [ऊष्-रुजायाम्-क]
—1 Salt ground; saline earth; कौशेयाविकयोरूषैः (शौचं विधीयते) Ms. 5. 120.
—2 An acid.
—3 A cleft, fissure.
—4 The cavity of the ear.
—5 The Malaya mountain.
—6 Dawn, day-break

—1 Black pepper.
—2 Ginger.
—3 The root Piper Longum.

उषणम् + .{@-णा@}
—1 Piper Longum.
—2 Piper Chaba (चविक).
—3 Dried ginger.

—1 Fire.
—2 The sun.

उषस् f.
—1 Dawn, morning; मधु नक्तमुतोषसः Bṛ. Up. प्रदीपाचिरिवोषसि
 R. 12. 1; उषसि उत्थाय rising at day-break.
—2 Morning light; cf. Aurora; (personified as the daughter of heaven and
 sister of the Ādityas).
—3 The deity that presides over the morning and evening twilights (used
 in dual); उषसौ or उषासौ.
—4 The outer passage of the ear.
—5 The Malaya range.
—6 Evening.

उषस् + .{@-सी@} The end of the day, evening twilight.
.━{@Comp.@}: उषःकरः, उषःकलः, उषःपतिः, उषोबुध्, उषोबुध
उषस् + -करः The moon.
उषस् + -कलः A cock.
उषस् + -पतिः Aniruddha.
उषासानक्तम् Ved. Dawn and night; उषासानक्ता पुरुधा विदाने Rv. 1. 122. 2.
उषस्य a. Sacred to the dawn. Vāj. 24. 4.
उषा + -कलः a cock.
उषा + -पतिः, -रमणः, -ईशः N. of Aniruddha, husband of Uṣā.
उषा + -पतिः, -रमणः, -ईशः N. of Aniruddha, husband of Uṣā.
उषङ्गुः N. of Śiva.

ऊषः + .({@-षम्@} according to some).
—7 Semen.

—1 Dawn, day-break.
—2 Salt; pepper.
ऊषणः The plant Plumbago Zeylanica (चित्रक).

ऊषर a. [ऊष-मत्वर्थीयो रः P. V. 2. 107] Impregnated with
 salt or saline particles.

ऊषर + .{@-रः, -रम्@} A barren spot with saline soil; न हि तस्मात्फलं
 तस्य सुकृष्टादूषरादिव Pt. 1. 47; Śi. 14. 46.
.━{@Comp.@}: ऊषरजम्

ऊषर + .{@-रः, -रम्@} A barren spot with saline soil; न हि तस्मात्फलं
 तस्य सुकृष्टादूषरादिव Pt. 1. 47; Śi. 14. 46.
.━{@Comp.@}: ऊषरजम्

ऊषर + -जम्
—1 Salt produced from salt soil.
—2 a kind of magnet.

ऊषरायते Den. Ā. To act like a salt desert (to allow no scope for
 the production of desires &c.); आजन्मनः स्मरोत्पत्तौ मानसेनोषरायितम् Pt. 5. 12.
ऊषवत् = ऊषर a. q. v.
